item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00031","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C23","C04","C12"],"selected_candidate_label":"C23","confidence":0.98,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C23 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. Both memoranda concern named taxpayers seeking private relief from a filing deadline for the 1951 tax year. They follow the same sequence: describe the proposed deadline waiver, recount the claimant's untimely filing and the revenue agency's lack of responsibility, then reject relief as discrimination against similarly situated taxpayers and an undesirable precedent before closing with nearly identical language. C04 and C12 share related statutory-limitation and equal-treatment reasoning, but their language and factual machinery are less closely aligned.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"The bill would provide that, notwithstanding any statutory period of limitation, refund or credit shall be made or allowed to the beneficiary of any overpayment of income tax for the year 1951","parent_excerpt":"The bill would provide that, for the purpose of determining the individual liability for income taxes for the taxable year 1951... [the elections] would be considered to have been filed within thirty days","explanation":"Both open by describing private legislation that retroactively excuses a tax-related filing deadline for the 1951 tax year."},{"child_excerpt":"The Internal Revenue Service did not match the taxpayer's prepayment documents with her return for 1951 and was not aware of the taxpayer's error.","parent_excerpt":"The records of the Treasury Department disclose that it was not involved in the untimely filing by these taxpayers of the elections.","explanation":"Each expressly establishes that the revenue authorities did not cause the claimant's filing failure."},{"child_excerpt":"Granting special relief in this case would constitute a discrimination against other taxpayers similarly situated and would create an undesirable precedent.","parent_excerpt":"The granting of special relief in this case would constitute an unfair discrimination against other taxpayers similarly situated and would create an undesirable precedent","explanation":"This is distinctive near-verbatim language stating the central policy basis for disapproval."},{"child_excerpt":"For these reasons I am constrained to withhold my approval from the bill.","parent_excerpt":"Under the circumstances, therefore, I am constrained to withhold my approval of the bill.","explanation":"The memoranda end with closely parallel operative conclusions."}]}
